note: These are exact per-tool browser audits observed on the stated commit. Evidence remains attached to that tested commit; the ledger records the current source commit separately and never upgrades untested checks to VERIFIED.

audits.step: Verify all 93 Celebrations tools on a mobile browser
audits.notes: The script iterates all 93 catalogue IDs and checks each tool's rendered experience at a 390x844 viewport. It does not establish every input, boundary case, permissions, token, backend, offline or native check.

audits.step: Verify local File workspace workflows in the browser
audits.notes: Six explicit routes are opened and their representative local file/folder workflows and output are checked; this is not exhaustive input/control coverage.

audits.step: Verify Zip any file compression and extraction in the browser
audits.notes: Browser test verifies multi-file and single-file ZIP creation, CRC-checked reads, extraction round-trip and no application API writes.

audits.step: Verify production (nested verify command: npm run audit:qr-barcode:browser)
audits.notes: The script generates QR and Code 128 fixtures, scans them through the reader, checks multi-code decoding and verifies local history after reload. It covers three exact tool IDs, not all 52 QR-category records.
The dedicated sandbox route is tested with local audio/tag fixtures and responsive browser viewports. This does not establish all music/audio tools or native implementations.
